# Rohit Builds — Full Content

Personal brand portfolio by Rohit Bhandari, live at https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io. This file is the full site content for LLMs and AI agents. Lightweight index in llms.txt.

## Home (Portfolio / Careers)

Designing data platforms that are readable, reliable, and ready to scale.
Subline: Azure Data Engineer evolving into a platform-minded architect.

Sections: hero with brand mark, proof cards (core technical strengths), case studies written for hiring managers, experience supporting the move toward architecture ownership, verified credentials validating hands-on skills, and a contact block. Currently open to Azure data engineering or architecture opportunities.

Contact: email rohitbhandari.work@gmail.com, GitHub github.com/rohitbhandariwork, LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/rohitonlinked, resume via Google Drive link on the page.

## News (flagship project)

A curated AI news portal with an editorial voice. Editions are dated (e.g. /news/2026-09-17/) and each edition carries a label, headline stories with source links, and a short personal take. The portal surfaces the latest AI developments in a digestible format.

## Shop (flagship project)

A storefront project page.

## Courses

Education system courses across the age groups:
- Bot Buddies (Ages 4-7)
- Code Kids (Ages 8-11)
- Code Quest (Ages 12-15)
- AI Lab (Ages 15-17)
- Career Launcher (Ages 18+)

Course structure includes modules such as logic basics (true vs false) inside Bot Buddies.

## Applications (Age groups)

Each age group has its own hub at /applications/[age]/ with age-appropriate apps and content. Five groups: 4-7, 8-11, 12-15, 15-17, 18+.

## Learning tools

- Pomoflow: a focus timer app for deep work sessions.
- Flashcard: a flashcard learning app for spaced memorization.
- Interview: an AI interview prep app for practicing answers.
- Jobtool: a job search helper tool.
